title: gitapex SSoT gate registry
description: Machine-readable registry of the repository's deterministic gates, their enforcement planes, the policy files they read, and the label-based agent routing table. Holds references and routing only, never policy values (the #1984 constraint). Normative schema for .gitapex/ssot.json; see docs/prd/gitapex-ssot-gate-registry.md. The paired validator scripts/scan_ssot_schema.py reads the plane and gate_kind enums from $defs so the two cannot drift, and enforces the referential-integrity rules JSON Schema cannot express.

plane.description: Closed enum of enforcement planes a gate can fire on. Read verbatim by scripts/scan_ssot_schema.py; extend here and the validator follows.

gate_kind.description: Whether the gate is a repository script or a GitHub-side native platform rule. Read verbatim by scripts/scan_ssot_schema.py.

body_read.description: How much of an issue/PR an agent may read before acting, per the routing rule. title-only means header labels plus title only.

meta.description: Registry metadata. schema_version pins the shape; tracking_issue is the design issue; phase records rollout state so the design doc never has to.

schema_version.description: Integer schema version; 1 is the phase-0 shape.

tracking_issue.description: Design issue number for the registry (references, not restated values).

status.description: Lifecycle status of the registry design, e.g. adopted-design.

phase.description: Migration phase this registry state reflects, e.g. phase-0.

policy_sources.description: The authoritative policy files the gates read. The registry points at them; each file stays the single source of truth for its own content.

path.description: Repository-relative path; must resolve to a tracked file.

format.description: Serialization format of the policy file.

authority.description: One line naming what this file is authoritative for.

gates.description: Every deterministic gate enumerated with its planes, trigger, one-line rule, and policy source references. Phase 0 seeds the PreToolUse plane; other planes land with the phase-1 drift gate.

kind.description: script (a tracked scripts/*.py) or native (a GitHub platform rule).

script.description: Present iff kind is script: repository-relative path to the gate script; must resolve to a tracked file.

native_rule.description: Present iff kind is native: the platform rule type it names, e.g. non_fast_forward.

rule.description: One-line statement of what the gate enforces.

planes.description: Enforcement planes this gate fires on (at least one).

trigger.description: The operation or tool surface that triggers the gate.

policy_refs.description: policy_sources[].id values this gate reads; empty when it reads no registered policy file.

cluster.description: clusters[].id this gate belongs to, or null when it is not part of a cross-plane cluster.

tracking_issue.description: Issue number that introduced or governs the gate, or null when unrecorded.

clusters.description: Named rules enforced on more than one plane. expected_planes records where the rule is meant to fire; a phase-1 drift gate reconciles that against the gates array.

id.description: Stable cluster identifier referenced by gates[].cluster.

rule.description: One-line statement of the shared rule.

expected_planes.description: Planes on which this rule is expected to be enforced.

label_routing.description: Machine form of the docs/runbooks/issue-triage.md Agent routing table. First-match-wins, ordered; exactly one default rule and it is last. Every label string resolves against the live catalog .github/labels.json only.

source_note.description: Pointer to the prose table this block encodes.

rules.description: Ordered routing rules; evaluated top to bottom, first match wins.

if_any.description: Rule matches when the issue carries any of these labels.

if_all.description: Rule matches when the issue carries all of these labels.

if_none.description: Additional guard: rule matches only when the issue carries none of these labels.

default.description: Present and true on exactly the final catch-all rule.

action.description: Routing action the agent takes on a match.

autonomous_pr.description: Whether an autonomous PR is permitted for this route.

label_consumers.description: Files that hardcode label literals (the #1041 inventory). Every label resolves against .github/labels.json unioned with the rename_from and retired tables of .github/label-policy.toml, so a legacy name recorded mid-migration stays detectable.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the consumer; must resolve to a tracked file.

note.description: One line on what the consumer does with the labels.
